title: Creative Head
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a Creative Manager to join our team and work closely with the evolving Maarrs product

portfolio.

This is not a conventional Creative Manager role.

The role combines hands\-on creative production, design execution, video creation, team formation and

leadership, and UI/UX quality oversight, and will require the individual to work across different creative

aspects of the product and business.

As an early\-stage startup, we believe that roles cannot always be restricted to a fixed job description.

Everyone is expected to contribute wherever required, take ownership and help build the organisation and

product.

Most importantly, we are not looking for someone who already knows everything.

Creative tools, production techniques, product knowledge and new AI\-enabled creative capabilities can all be

learned and developed over time. What is much harder to teach is attitude, ownership, work ethic, curiosity,

adaptability and willingness to learn and contribute.

That is what we value most.

**What We Are Looking For**

**We are looking for someone who:**

 Has a strong work ethic and takes ownership of commitments.

 Has a genuine willingness to work and contribute, rather than waiting to be told what to do.

 Is curious and has a willingness to explore, question and understand.

 Is willing to learn new creative skills, tools and ways of working.

 Can operate comfortably in an environment where things are still being built and refined.

 Is flexible and adaptable when priorities or responsibilities change.

 Can work across creative functions rather than being restricted by a narrow job description.

 Is comfortable taking responsibility for something and following it through to completion.

 Can think beyond the immediate creative task and understand where the product and brand are heading in the

future.

 Wants to build their own capabilities and career alongside the growth of the product and organisation.

 Has good professional ethics, reliability and discipline.

 Can work independently while also collaborating effectively with others.

 Brings structure and clarity even when the situation itself is not completely structured.

The role will broadly operate across creative production, design, video and creative team management:

 Work closely with the CEO on creative execution and production priorities.

 Build, develop and lead the creative team across design and video functions, with hands\-on creative

production remaining a core responsibility.

 Oversee the UI/UX and front\-end design department — reviewing and ensuring quality of output, not hands\-on

execution.

 Drive creative marketing ideas and campaign concepts.

 Create and execute end\-to\-end video production, including 2D animation, 3D animation, motion graphics,

AI\-generated video and video editing, while also overseeing the quality and delivery of video outputs.

 Design and oversee brand assets including logos, posters, full branding kits, letterheads and marketing

collateral.

 Manage design and video workflows from brief to final delivery across multiple concurrent projects.

 Maintain production quality and ensure creative outputs are delivered to the required standard and within

agreed timelines.

 Coordinate creative priorities across multiple projects and ensure that agreed actions are followed through to

completion.

 Provide creative direction and quality review while remaining hands\-on where production execution is required.

**Creative Skills \& Experience**

The following would be advantageous, with strong practical proficiency expected for the core production tools:

 Adobe Premiere Pro.

 Adobe After Effects.

 Adobe Photoshop.

 Adobe Illustrator.

 DaVinci Resolve (color grading).

 Canva (professional\-level use).

 Figma (UI/UX design).

 2D animation and motion graphics.

 3D animation.

 AI video generation tools.

 Video editing and post\-production.

 Brand identity design, including logos, letterheads and full branding systems.

 Poster and marketing collateral design.

 UI/UX oversight and quality review of application design and front\-end output.

 Creative team leadership and creative workflow management.

Added advantage (not mandatory):

 Pre\-production experience, including script writing.

 Cinematography knowledge — camera positioning, shot composition, and the ability to advise across

production departments.

A strong portfolio demonstrating expert\-level execution across design AND video disciplines simultaneously is

important. Proven experience leading a creative team, working directly with executive leadership, and

independently managing multiple creative workflows end\-to\-end would be advantageous.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Client Account Manager
description:
Role Summary: As a Client Account Manager ,you will be responsible for managing and maintaining relationships with key clients and ensuring their satisfaction with our products and services. You will serve as the primary point of contact for clients and will be responsible for managing the entire client lifecycle, including on boarding, account management ,and renewal.

Responsibilities: Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, managing all aspects of the client relationship. Understand clients' business needs and goals and develop customized solutions to meet their needs Act as a subject matter expert on our products and services ,providing guidance and support to clients Identify and pursue up selling and cross\-selling opportunities to drive revenue growth Work with internal teams to ensure timely and accurate delivery of products and services Monitor client accounts to identify and address any issues or concerns in a timely manner PUBLIC Conduct regular meetings with clients to review performance, address any issues, and identify opportunities for improvement Ensure that all client communication is professional, timely, and effective Assist with the on boarding process for new clients, including training and on boarding support. Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients through regular communication and proactive account management Participate in sales and marketing activities to promote our products and services to potential clients.

Requirements: Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field 0\-3years of experience in account management, preferably in a B2C environment Strong communication and interpersonal skills Excellent problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities

Experience with CRM systems and strong computer skills Knowledge of our products and services is a plus.

Pay: Up to ₹550,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
* Plan and execute **B2B digital marketing campaigns** across relevant digital channels.
* Manage and optimize the company’s **website, landing pages, and online presence**.
* Handle **Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads** and other paid campaigns for lead generation.
* Conduct **keyword research, SEO activities, and website optimization** to improve organic traffic.
* Develop engaging **content, creatives, blogs, product posts, and marketing materials** for B2B audiences.
* Generate and nurture leads through digital campaigns and coordinate with the sales team for follow\-up.
* Manage company **LinkedIn and social media pages** and maintain a consistent brand presence.
* Monitor campaign performance, website traffic, lead quality, conversion rates, and ROI.
* Prepare **weekly/monthly digital marketing reports** with insights and recommendations.
* Conduct competitor and market research to identify new digital marketing opportunities.

* Use **Google Analytics, Search Console, CRM, and other marketing tools** to track and analyze performance.
* Support email marketing, WhatsApp marketing, remarketing, and other B2B lead\-generation initiatives.
* Continuously test and optimize campaigns to improve **CPL, lead quality, and conversion**.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Job Overview

We are looking for a **Digital Marketing Executive** to support our online marketing activities, brand visibility, lead generation, and digital campaigns.

Key Responsibilities

* Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns across various online platforms.
* Manage and grow social media presence and engagement.
* Create and coordinate content for social media, websites, blogs, and marketing campaigns.
* Handle **SEO, SEM, Google Ads, and social media advertising**.
* Monitor website traffic, campaign performance, and lead generation.
* Analyse marketing data and prepare regular performance reports.
* Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and market research.
* Coordinate with the sales and content teams to support business and lead\-generation activities.
* Stay updated with the latest digital marketing trends and tools.

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in **Marketing, Digital Marketing, Communications, or a related field**.
* 0–2 years of experience in digital marketing; freshers with relevant knowledge/projects may also apply.
* Basic knowledge of **SEO, Google Ads, Social Media Marketing, Google Analytics, and content marketing**.
* Good communication and content\-writing skills.
* Creative mindset with strong attention to detail.
* Ability to analyse campaign performance and work with data.
* Candidates with hands\-on experience in digital marketing tools will be preferred.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work in a growing **EdTech \& technology company**.
* Hands\-on exposure to multiple digital marketing channels.
* Learning and career growth opportunities.
* Professional and collaborative work environment.
